res=s-(a*base+b)\n        else:\n            res=s-base\n        w=wmean.loc[d].reindex(piv.index)\n        cs=sorted(((abs(np.corrcoef(res,w[c])[0,1]),c) for c in drivers), reverse=True)\n        out[sid]=dict(best=cs[0][0], drv=cs[0][1], dom=cs[0][0]-cs[1][0])\n    D=pd.DataFrame(out).T\n    D['score']=D.best.astype(float)+D.dom.astype(float)   # strength + neatness\n    return D.sort_values('score',ascending=False)\n\nfor agg in ['median','mean']:\n    for gf in [False,True]:\n        D=weather_rank(agg,gf)\n        top5=D.head(5)\n        print(f'agg={agg} gainfit={gf}:  ' + ' | '.join(f\"{i}:{r.drv[:4]} b={float(r.best):.2f} d={float(r.dom):.2f}\" for i,r in top5.iterrows()))\n\n# rhythm robustness: same-pollutant district baseline, EXCL removed\nprint('\\nRhythm (same-district same-pollutant z-mean baseline, EXCL out):')\nz=(piv-piv.mean())/piv.std(); mean_z=(piv[sid].mean()-gm.mean())/gm.std()\n    std_ratio=piv[sid].std()/piv[peers].std().median()\n    sw=swing(sid)/np.median([swing(c) for c in peers])\n    bz=zi[peers].mean(axis=1); lg={}\n    for L in range(-3,4):\n        ss=zi[sid].shift(L); m=ss.notna(); lg[L]=np.corrcoef(ss[m],bz[m])[0,1]\n    bL=max(lg,key=lambda k:lg[k])\n    rows.append(dict(sid=sid,dist=d,poll=p,r1=cs[0][0],drv=cs[0][1][:4],dom=cs[0][0]-cs[1][0],\n                     mean_z=mean_z,std_ratio=std_ratio,swing=sw,lagL=bL,laggain=lg[bL]-lg[0]))\ndf=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('sid')\ndf['wscore']=df.r1+df.dom\nordinary=(df.mean_z.abs()<2)&(df.std_ratio.between(0.7,1.4))&(df.swing.between(0.75,1.35))&(df.laggain<0.05)\nprint('WEATHER slot — ordinary-in-aggregate stations ranked by r1+dominance:')\nprint(df[ordinary].sort_values('wscore',ascending=False).head(8).round(3).to_string())\nprint('\\nSame ranking WITHOUT ordinariness filter:')\nprint(df.sort_values('wscore',ascending=False).head(8).round(3).to_string())\nEOF","description":"Definitive weather-slot ranking with ordinariness constraints"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5140,"cache_read_input_tokens":49294,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":5140,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9a74093f-05fb-4f16-8df7-5c3beaf3913b","uuid":"0e8bc9d9-6f41-4bb4-b6d0-8efd8186d552","request_id":"req_011CcrjZB5uKCPDPBCHrnxVf"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrjdiSfEptjUSLW1Qzy8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HsLUrtVMotHFGbkLTWWN8p","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nrd = pd.read_csv('readings.csv', parse_dates=['timestamp'])\nst = pd.read_csv('stations.csv')\nrd = rd.merge(st[['station_id','district']], on='station_id')\npoll = rd[['station_id','pollutant']].drop_duplicates().set_index('station_id')['pollutant']\ndist = st.set_index('station_id')['district']\npiv = rd.pivot(index='timestamp', columns='station_id', values='current_reading').sort_index()\npivi = piv.interpolate(method='time', limit_direction='both')\n\nfor sid in ['ST014','ST051']:\n    d,p=dist[sid],poll[sid]\n    peers=[c for c in piv.columns if c!=sid and dist[c]==d and poll[c]==p and c not in {'ST040','ST066'}]\n    base=pivi[peers].mean(axis=1)\n    print(f'=== {sid} ({d},{p}) vs peer mean ===')\n    T=pd.DataFrame({'station':pivi[sid].round(1),'peers':base.round(1)})\n    print(T.T.to_string())\n    dd=pivi[sid].diff().abs().mean(); db=base.diff().abs().mean()\n    print(f'mean |4h-step| station={dd:.2f} vs peer-mean={db:.2f}; corr={np.corrcoef(pivi[sid],base)[0,1]:.2f}\\n')\nEOF","description":"Visual sanity check of ST014 phase shift and ST051 smoothing"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5421,"cache_read_input_tokens":54434,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":5421,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9a74093f-05fb-4f16-8df7-5c3beaf3913b","uuid":"e2d735d5-7793-4c24-9841-735145244803","request_id":"req_011CcrjdhEUqYtBayUQgV7B2"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ccrjjje1ms47Q7oXHKgj9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Cqwa5M2Uve4paKHuScqgB1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"\"\"\"Air-quality network audit: identify the 3 faulty stations.\n\nMethod\n------\nEach station reports one pollutant, 24 four-hourly readings. Short gaps are\ntime-interpolated (missingness itself is never used as a signal). For every\nstation a leave-one-out peer baseline is built from stations in the same\ndistrict measuring the same pollutant (known-bad stations excluded from\nbaselines). Three independent detectors then target the three described\nfault types:\n\n1. RHYTHM  - z-scored series cross-correlated with the peer baseline at lags\n   -3..+3 (4h steps). A station whose correlation improves the most at a\n   nonzero lag follows the local pattern but out of phase.\n   -> ST014 (corr 0.39 at lag 0 rises to 0.55 at a 12h shift; its diurnal\n      peak sits 1-2 slots away from the peers' morning/evening peaks).\n\n2. MUTED SWINGS - mean |step-to-step change| computed on observed pairs only,\n   divided by the median of the same statistic over peers. Low ratio with a\n   healthy correlation to peers = plausible point-by-point, damped dynamics.\n   -> ST051 (swing ratio 0.37, the extreme of the network, while correlating\n      0.61 with the peer mean; ST060's low ratio is an interpolation artifact\n      of it having 9/24 gaps, so it is rejected as a missingness decoy).\n\n3. WEATHER-COUPLED RESIDUALS - a gain/offset fit of the station on its peer\n   baseline removes scale mismatch; the remaining residual is correlated with\n   the four district-mean weather drivers. The fault shows a high correlation\n   with exactly one driver and near-zero with the rest.\n   -> ST066 (residual vs rain_accumulation r = -0.65 while every other driver\n      is |r| <= 0.15 - twice the dominance of any other station; its mean\n      level is ordinary among peers).\n\nDecoys rejected: ST040 (mean 170 vs peers ~43 - a gross calibration offset,\nnot one of the described behaviors; also excluded from all baselines),\nST060 (heaviest missingness), ST023 (weaker drift, within the noise tail).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\nDATA = \"/app/dataset\"\nDRIVERS = [\"temperature_c\", \"humidity_pct\", \"wind_speed_m_s\", \"rain_accumulation_mm\"]\n# gross-offset station kept out of every peer baseline\nOFFSET_DECOYS = {\"ST040\"}\n\n\ndef load():\n    rd = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/readings.csv\", parse_dates=[\"timestamp\"])\n    st = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/stations.csv\")\n    wr = pd.read_csv(f\"{DATA}/weather_readings.csv\", parse_dates=[\"timestamp\"])\n    rd = rd.merge(st[[\"station_id\", \"district\"]], on=\"station_id\")\n    poll = rd[[\"station_id\", \"pollutant\"]].drop_duplicates().set_index(\"station_id\")[\"pollutant\"]\n    dist = st.set_index(\"station_id\")[\"district\"]\n    piv = rd.pivot(index=\"timestamp\", columns=\"station_id\", values=\"current_reading\").sort_index()\n    wmean = wr.groupby([\"district\", \"timestamp\"])[DRIVERS].mean()\n    return piv, poll, dist, wmean\n\n\ndef peers_of(sid, piv, poll, dist, excl):\n    same = [c for c in piv.columns\n            if c != sid and c not in excl and dist[c] == dist[sid] and poll[c] == poll[sid]]\n    if len(same) >= 3:\n        return same\n    return [c for c in piv.columns if c != sid and c not in excl and poll[c] == poll[sid]]\n\n\ndef answer() -> set[str]:\n    piv, poll, dist, wmean = load()\n    pivi = piv.interpolate(method=\"time\", limit_direction=\"both\")\n    z = (piv - piv.mean()) / piv.std()\n    zi = z.interpolate(method=\"time\", limit_direction=\"both\")\n    n_missing = piv.isna().sum()\n\n    def obs_swing(col):\n        o = piv[col]\n        ok = o.notna() & o.shift(1).notna()\n        return o.diff()[ok].abs().mean()\n\n    rows = []\n    for sid in piv.columns:\n        peers = peers_of(sid, piv, poll, dist, OFFSET_DECOYS | {sid})\n\n        # 1) rhythm: lagged correlation against z-scored peer mean\n        base_z = zi[peers].mean(axis=1)\n        lag_r = {}\n        for lag in range(-3, 4):\n            shifted = zi[sid].shift(lag)\n            m = shifted.notna()\n            lag_r[lag] = np.corrcoef(shifted[m], base_z[m])[0, 1]\n        best_lag = max(lag_r, key=lag_r.get)\n        lag_gain = lag_r[best_lag] - lag_r[0] if best_lag != 0 else 0.0\n\n        # 2) muted swings: observed-only step size vs peers\n        swing_ratio = obs_swing(sid) / np.median([obs_swing(c) for c in peers])\n        peer_corr = np.corrcoef(pivi[sid], pivi[peers].mean(axis=1))[0, 1]\n\n        # 3) weather coupling: gain-corrected residual vs district weather\n        base = pivi[peers].mean(axis=1)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(base, pivi[sid], 1)\n        res = pivi[sid] - (a * base + b)\n        w = wmean.loc[dist[sid]].reindex(piv.index)\n        cs = sorted((abs(np.corrcoef(res, w[c])[0, 1]) for c in DRIVERS), reverse=True)\n        weather_score = cs[0] + (cs[0] - cs[1])  # strength + one-driver dominance\n\n        rows.append((sid, lag_gain, swing_ratio, peer_corr, weather_score, n_missing[sid]))\n\n    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=[\"sid\", \"lag_gain\", \"swing_ratio\",\n                                     \"peer_corr\", \"weather_score\", \"n_missing\"]).set_index(\"sid\")\n\n    picked = []\n    # rhythm: largest improvement from shifting\n    picked.append(df[\"lag_gain\"].idxmax())\n    # muted: smallest swing ratio among stations that still track peers and are\n    # not gap-heavy (interpolation over long gaps fakes smoothness)\n    muted_pool = df[(df[\"peer_corr\"] > 0.4) & (df[\"n_missing\"] <= 6) & (~df.index.isin(picked))]\n    picked.append(muted_pool[\"swing_ratio\"].idxmin())\n    # weather: strongest single-driver residual coupling, offset decoy excluded\n    weather_pool = df[(~df.index.isin(picked)) & (~df.index.isin(OFFSET_DECOYS))]\n    picked.append(weather_pool[\"weather_score\"].idxmax())\n\n    return set(picked)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    result = answer()\n    print(sorted(result))\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(result, f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6576,"cache_read_input_tokens":59855,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6576,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9a74093f-05fb-4f16-8df7-5c3beaf3913b","uuid":"63c77a51-24da-4d28-b97e-9c7d5080c98d","request_id":"req_011CcrjjghuRavqumkgH3upt"}
